access.api-keys[].secret: A client key the proxy accepts; it grants use of every login behind the proxy.

access.key-allowlist[].api-key.secret: A client key from access.api-keys; its entry decides which logins behind the proxy it may use.

access.key-allowlist[].credentials[].acc.secret: An OAuth account email used to select logins without exposing the account in generated configuration.

api-keys.*[].headers.<name>.secret: An upstream request header, which can carry a credential (an Authorization value).

api-keys.*[].keys[].headers.<name>.secret: An upstream request header, which can carry a credential (an Authorization value).

api-keys.*[].keys[].proxy-url.secret: A proxy URL, which can carry a user and password (socks5://user:pass@host:port).

api-keys.*[].proxy-url.secret: A proxy URL, which can carry a user and password (socks5://user:pass@host:port).

management.secret-key.secret: The management API key; CPA hashes a plaintext value into its own config at start.

oauth.credential-overrides[].account.secret: An OAuth account email matched against login metadata.

oauth.credential-overrides[].base-url.secret: A provider-specific upstream URL, which can carry credentials.

oauth.credential-overrides[].headers.<na.secret: An upstream request header, which can carry a credential.

oauth.credential-overrides[].proxy-url.secret: A proxy URL, which can carry a user and password.

requests.proxy-url.secret: A proxy URL, which can carry a user and password (socks5://user:pass@host:port).

server.github-token.secret: A GitHub token CPA sends with its release and asset downloads.

server.tls.key.secretFile: The TLS private key file the HTTPS listener loads.
